Master: contract. Trifle

Tap a ready Independent Assamite you control to put this card on a younger
vampire. Every Independent...

---

My question is: Can I put this card in play without tapping a ready
Independent Assamite? If so then I presume that I can then tap later to put
this card on an appropriate vampire. Also, depending on the first answer,
can I tap again even later to again put it on yet another appropriate
vampire.

OR

Do I tap the vampire when the card comes into play? Full stop.

Thanks in advance,

John

Messages.Author: de...@hell.is
Messages.Body:
you have to tap an independent assamite and put this card on a vampire
younger vampire than that assamite when you play this card. the card
provides no alternative options for playing it.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
John Alston-Campbell wrote:

> Master: contract. Trifle
>
> Tap a ready Independent Assamite you control to put this card on a younger
> vampire. Every Independent...
>
> ---
>
> My question is: Can I put this card in play without tapping a ready
> Independent Assamite?

No. You have to tap a ready Independent Assamite you control to put this

card on a younger vampire.

>If so then I presume that I can then tap later to put

> this card on an appropriate vampire. Also, depending on the first answer,
> can I tap again even later to again put it on yet another appropriate
> vampire.

It cannot be moved once placed.

> OR
>
> Do I tap the vampire when the card comes into play? Full stop.

You tap the vampire to put the card in play. Full stop.
